When Jitendra Lalwani’s father needed urgent care, the ambulance took over an hour to arrive. That devastating helplessness became his life’s work. Today, his fleet of Tata Ambulances spans 850 cities, ensuring no other family suffers the panic of waiting. When you are racing against time, you need a machine you can trust implicitly. Compassionate visionaries like Jitendra prove that a citizen’s resolve to save lives can transform the nation; Kyunki Bharat humse aage badhta hai.
